answers.core: It just feels like something that should be in the engine.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around with a few lines of script, but since this very silently bloats projects, it will usually not be done in practice. Everyone I told about this was surprised Godot wasn't already optimizing translations on export.

Doing this manually is also a bit of a bother. And it will benefit all .po users, even if the benefits are the greatest for games with lots of translation comments aiming for the web.

title: Ship compiled .mo instead of raw .po (strip comments by default)
